answer: Whisper-relay: a sealed whisper travels from an island beacon to the harbor through three strangers. Each willow post stamps its hop with its own key; a hop back to the sender's key burns the bond. A hop costs 40 credits, so one relay costs 120. Forging 1,000 identities needs 1,000 fresh relays and 120,000 credits, no bulk discount; an honest agent pays 120 once. A rented relay fails: the harbor checks the stamps are strangers.
